source_book: Sri Chaitanya — FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students, Mathematics-IA and Mathematics-IB (2026-27 edition)
note: The two model papers the book prints on its own last pages (MODEL PAPER-IA, book p.132; MODEL PAPER-IB, book p.232). Held as a COVERAGE TEST, not as content: for each question we record which chapter it belongs to and, where our bank answers it, the question_id. Stems are restated in our own wording; the mathematics is exact. No solution content appears here, by policy. These are a coaching publisher's model papers, NOT TSBIE papers - they are evidence of what the book expects to be asked, not of what a board actually asked, and nothing here may be rendered to a student as exam history.

shape.sections: I. Very Short Answer 1-10 · II. Short Answer 11-18 · III. Long Answer 19-21
shape.why_it_matters: 10 + 8 + 3 = 21 questions is exactly the ABC_60 shape PAPER_PATTERNS already encodes for mathematics and mathematics_1b, printed independently in both volumes.

questions.stem: Find the power set of A = {−3, 0, 3}.
Find the 10th term of the A.P. 3, 5, 7, 9, …
If f : R → R and f(x) = (1 − x²)/(1 + x²), show that f(tan θ) = cos 2θ.
Equate two 3×3 matrices and find x, y, z and a.
If the given 3×3 matrix is symmetric, find x.
If ā = ī − 2j̄, find a vector in the direction of ā with magnitude 7 units.
Find the period of tan(x + 4x + 9x + … + n²x).
Find the range of 7 cos x − 24 sin x + 5.
If sinh x = 3, show that x = logₑ(3 + √10).
In triangle ABC with a = 2 cm, b = 3 cm, c = 4 cm, find cos A.
Given f and g⁻¹ as sets of ordered pairs, show that (g∘f)⁻¹ = f⁻¹∘g⁻¹.
Prove 2 + 7 + 12 + … + (5n − 3) = n(5n − 1)/2 for all n ∈ N by induction.
Show that the determinant with rows (bc, b+c, 1), (ca, c+a, 1), (ab, a+b, 1) equals (a−b)(b−c)(c−a).
For non-coplanar ā, b̄, c̄, verify the collinearity of the points with position vectors ā−2b̄+3c̄, 2ā+3b̄−4c̄, −7b̄+10c̄.
If ā = 2ī+2j̄−3k̄ and b̄ = 3ī−j̄+2k̄, find the angle between 2ā+b̄ and ā+2b̄.
Find the general solution of 2sin²θ − 4 = 5cos θ.
Find the value of sin(cos⁻¹(4/5) + cos⁻¹(12/13)).
In triangle ABC prove (1/r − 1/r₁)(1/r − 1/r₂)(1/r − 1/r₃) = abc/Δ³ = 4R/(r²s²).
Solve 2x − y + 3z = 8, −x + 2y + z = 4, 3x + y − 4z = 0 by the matrix inversion method.
For ā = ī−2j̄−3k̄, b̄ = 2ī+j̄−k̄, c̄ = ī+3j̄−2k̄, verify that ā×(b̄×c̄) ≠ (ā×b̄)×c̄.
If A, B, C are angles of a triangle, prove sin 2A − sin 2B + sin 2C = 4 cos A sin B cos C.
Find x if the slope of the line through (2, 5) and (x, 3) is 2.
Find the distance between the parallel lines 3x − 4y = 12 and 3x − 4y = 7.
Find the distance of P(3, 2, 4) from the origin.
Reduce the equation of the plane x + 2y − 3z − 6 = 0 to normal form.
Compute lim(x → 1) (2x + 1)/(3x² − 4x + 5).
Compute lim(x → 0) (e⁷ˣ − 1)/x.
Find the derivative of (x² − 3)(4x³ + 1).
Find the derivative of tan⁻¹(log x).
If the side of a square increases by 4%, find the approximate percentage increase in its area.
If y = x⁴, find the average rate of change of y between x = 2 and x = 4.
Find the equation of the locus of a point which forms a triangle of area 2 with A(1, 1) and B(−2, 3).
When the axes are rotated through an angle α, find the transformed equation of x cos α + y sin α − p = 0.
Find the distance between the pair of parallel lines 9x² − 6xy + y² + 18x − 6y + 8 = 0.
Find the condition for the chord lx + my = 1 of the circle x² + y² = a² (centre the origin) to subtend a right angle at the origin.
Show that f, defined by f(x) = (cos ax − cos bx)/x² for x ≠ 0 and f(0) = (1/2)(b² − a²), is continuous at 0.
Find the derivative of ax² + bx + c from the first principle.
Find the equation of the tangent and the normal to the curve xy = 10 at (2, 5).
The profit function of a company selling x items per day is P(x) = (150 − x)x − 1000. Find the number of items for maximum profit, and the maximum profit.
If p and q are the lengths of the perpendiculars from the origin to x sec α + y cosec α = a and x cos α − y sin α = a cos 2α, prove that 4p² + q² = a².
The vertices of a triangle are A(1, 4, 2), B(−2, 1, 2), C(2, 3, −4). Find ∠A, ∠B and ∠C.
If y = x√(a² + x²) + a² log(x + √(a² + x²)), prove that dy/dx = 2√(a² + x²).
